body: Will need to investigate, we are just using minimatch to match the pattern against the filename, so we will need to take a close look.

This is an expected behavior of minimatch. In order to conditionally match at the front of a pattern, you'd need to do this:

```
**/foo.js
```

I'm not sure if there's a change for us to make here.

Probably, eslint could change how it uses minimatch. For instance, eslint could pass paths relative to working directory, like it does for other files.
That would allow to enable the same behavior regardless of how a path to a given file is specified.

```
/home/user/my-project $ eslint /home/user/my-project/foo.js
/home/user/my-project $ eslint foo.js
/home/user/my-project $ eslint ../my-project/foo.js
```

This has been a long standing issue, either the answer is https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/2365#issuecomment-100523132 or the solution would be a breaking change (might change if I invest more time)
I think long term we need to make .eslintignore act just like .gitignore. That would be a breaking change, so probably hold off until we are ready for 2.0
If thats the plan then lets add the milestone 2.0 here. And also add breaking?

This issue is a tracking issue so we can more easily see what we're working towards for ESLint v2.0.0. These tasks won't necessarily wait for 2.0.0, but rather, we will know it's time for 2.0.0 once the non-breaking items in this list are complete. At that point, we can start working on the breaking changes and prepare for 2.0.0. For context on many of these, see #2203.

These are _not_ in priority order:
- [x] Autofixing certain errors (lead: @nzakas, #3134)
- [x] Autocreate configuration based on code sample (lead: @ianvs #3567)
- [x] Suffixed `.eslintrc` files (lead: @nzakas, #4045)
- [x] Code path analysis (lead: @mysticatea, #3530)
- [x] **Breaking:** Treat `package.json` like `.eslintrc` (lead: @nzakas, #4451)
- [x] **Breaking:** Update `eslint:recommended` rules list (lead: ?)
- [x] **Breaking:** Create `yield-star-spacing` (lead: ?, #4115)
- [x] **Breaking:** Move ES6 globals from `builtin` to `es6` environment (lead: @nzakas, #4085)
- [x] **Breaking:** Cleaner JSON Schemas for rules (lead: @btmills , #3625)
- [x] **Breaking:** Make `.eslintignore` work exactly like `.gitignore` (lead: @JulianLaval, #2365)
- [x] **Breaking:** Ignore bower_components by default (lead: @JulianLaval, #3550)

This issue will be closed when all of the subissues are complete. We may add more into this list as needed.

```
 └┬─ client
  └┬─ modules
   └┬─ some-module
```

```
lib/
!lib/client/modules
```

File index.js is linted (as expected) if I run either of these commands in my project dir:

```
eslint lib/client/modules/some-module/index.js
eslint lib/client/modules
```

However, these commands do not lint index.js:

```
eslint lib/client
eslint .
```
